name: Kwela whistle runs
desc: The playful, chattering side of the pennywhistle: fast kwela-style runs skipping up and down the D-minor pentatonic with a tight sixteenth-delay, brighter and more present than its airy sibling. Full runs a looping figure that speeds up every four cycles; peak turns virtuosic with an octave shimmer. Street-corner joy.

code.full: note("<[d5 f5 g5 a5 g5 f5 d5 f5] [a5 c6 a5 g5 f5 g5 a5 g5]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").vib(${vibr}).vibmod(${vibd}).attack(.04).decay(.25).sustain(.25).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(4500,7000).slow(24)).room(.35).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.35).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.fast(1.5)).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[d5 f5 g5 a5 c6 a5 g5 f5 g5 a5 f5 g5 e5 f5 d5 e5] [a5 c6 d6 c6 a5 g5 f5 g5 a5 f5 g5 e5 f5 d5 e5 <c5 d5>]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").vib(${vibr}*1.2).vibmod(${vibd}).attack(.03).decay(.2).sustain(.22).release(.12).lpf(sine.range(5000,8000).slow(16)).room(.3).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.35).gain(${gain}).off(1/16, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.25)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).orbit(5).play()
